summary: The declared stress, multi-surface and fresh-critic dependencies all returned, so readiness is decidable. Graduation to production /w is not supported. Real value is demonstrated in prepared distinct allocation, dynamic dependency activation, a runnable Context Fabric P1 candidate, deterministic G1->G2 Planner generation, successful stale recovery, and four-surface coordination. Production remains blocked by non-atomic recovery/portfolio ownership, missing complete scale/productivity denominators, partial same-chat continuation, incomplete live Context Fabric verification, non-replayable hardened RETURN->ledger->source-builder recursion, no G2->G3 lifecycle, and candidate-only multi-surface evidence without browser/device E2E or resolved public routes.

mechanism_grades.evidence: 52/52 static READY opportunity IDs had claim paths; this is allocation saturation, not completion/launch count.
Blocked successors acquired claims only after qualifying dependency RETURN evidence.
Stress evidence recorded four overlapping recovery claims -> one surviving RETURN + three competing boundaries.
At least two unexpired claims for the same Student World bridge dedupe key persisted eight seconds apart; atomic-pin repair is derived but not yet production proof.
Live recovery completed the >3h stale multi-surface integration while preserving original bytes and lineage.
Continuation code/tests and live successor activation exist, but stress evidence lacks integrated same-chat RETURN->reload->next-claim proof.
Durable proposal fingerprint pins exist; host-level concurrent ownership is not universally proven.

Actual launch count, global idle ratio, global collision rate and useful durable results per human intervention remain UNKNOWN; the metrics return is a contract and the suggested compile-progress-metrics script is absent.
Runnable candidate passed 12/12 isolated tests; prior context-use canary is PARTIAL_EXPECTED_FAILURE and live repository recall/efficiency/stale-head verification remains pending.
Four surfaces, local planner/steward independence, shared owners and static demand derivation pass; no fresh Node/browser/device E2E and all four public routes remain UNRESOLVED.
G1->G2 deterministic generation and zero human task wording are proven; hardened disposition ledger is bypassed, deterministic source-builder is absent, and emitted G2 VERIFY has not produced G3.
Fresh critic compared three architectures and preferred demand-gated local swarms plus deterministic metabolism over broad fan-out as default.
Readiness evidence cannot itself create production /w, Current, Human Accepted or Served state.

blocking_conditions.minimum_evidence: Global launch/idle/collision/useful-per-human metrics become COMPUTED or coverage-bounded PARTIAL rather than UNKNOWN.

blocking_conditions.condition: Run Context Fabric against a pinned live-repository inventory with automated selection provenance.
blocking_conditions.minimum_evidence: Required source/authority/contradiction recall passes, stale-head invalidation is observed, and file/token reduction is measured against inventory denominator.

blocking_conditions.condition: Wire immutable RETURNs through validated hardened disposition ledger into deterministic executable Planner source-builder.
blocking_conditions.minimum_evidence: Same pinned inputs reproduce next source/output/queue and invalid/missing dispositions fail closed.

blocking_conditions.condition: Execute emitted G2 VERIFY and use terminal evidence through the same path to generate G3 with zero human task wording.
Persist an integrated fresh /wc RETURN->reload->next useful claim/STARTED receipt.
After B1-B6, compare pinned 1/5/20-worker cohorts with complete denominators and fresh critic before new readiness.

recursive autonomous metabolism is fully operational
next_gate: Keep /wc canary. Consume existing atomicity, metrics and recursive-ingestion repair work, finish live Context Fabric verification, then rerun controlled scale verification plus fresh critic. A separate authority action remains required for any production /w promotion.
